tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search the Socketlist directory of open-source MCP servers by keyword (name, description, topics). Results are ranked by relevance, then GitHub stars.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Get details for one MCP server by its Socketlist slug: description, repository, stars, category, README-derived features/tools/requirements and, when known, a ready-made install config copied from the README.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all Socketlist categories with their slugs and number of servers.

tools.name: best_for
tools.description: Return the curated "best MCP servers for X" list for a use case or client (e.g. "claude-code", "jira", "postgresql", "web-scraping"). Call with an unknown value to get the list of available use cases.
